report.answer_text:
Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) won the 2025 Tour de France, his fourth title. He beat Jonas Vingegaard (Visma-Lease a Bike) by 4:24 in the final general classification.[1]
Florian Lipowitz (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) completed the podium.[1] He finished 11:00 behind Pogačar[1].
The 4:24 margin was Pogačar's second largest at the Tour, after the 6:17 he won by over Vingegaard in 2024.[2]
The race started in Lille on Saturday 5 July 2025 and finished in Paris on Sunday 27 July.[3]
